title: onboarding.milestone.due.v1
description: Producer: Onboarding. A pre-boarding touchpoint (T-21, T-7, IT provisioning) or probation milestone (Day 30/60/90, review, end) reached its due date (RCU-ONB-001/004). Notification reminds assigneeRoles and, for probation milestones, the reporting manager. On probation-review and probation-end, departmentHeadId is the joiner's department head, who decides (RCU-ONB-005); with no head on record it is absent and hrhead is in assigneeRoles. Subject: OnboardingCase/<onbId>.

milestone.description: Kind, e.g. engagement-t21, it-provisioning, probation-check-in, probation-review, probation-end.

departmentHeadId.description: probation-review and probation-end only: user id of the department head who decides; optional.
